scope: Phase 1: the pure materialization plan and the eager local worker materializer. Unit tests and tests over a temporary bare Git repository; no dispatch, worker job, authority provider or restricted runtime.
immediate_outcome: A complete projection materializes into a verified, sealed immutable input with a reusable identity and into private writable overlays per attempt and fence; missing, corrupt, damaged, truncated and unbound state is refused without publishing or overwriting anything.
durable_capability: kiln_core::projection::materialization (plan, MaterializationPlan, overlay_identity) and kiln_web_service::worker::materialize (prepare_input, prepare_overlay).
ordering: The proposal, design and tasks gates passed before implementation.

checks.result: pass: repeated materialization, overlay isolation and resumption, missing, corrupt, damaged, truncated and unbound refusals, and an interrupted preparation never adopted

checks.command: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p onix-kiln-core -p kiln-web-service --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all --check

cargo_environment.wrapper: dev-shell environment with pkg-config and OpenSSL and a private TMPDIR

remaining: Pin source, definition, manifest, materializer profile and overlay generation in dispatch and retained workspace metadata.
Apply #69/#70 authority at retrieval and workspace effects; qualify restricted-runtime negatives and the two-project build profile of #77.
non_claims: Materializing grants no read, write or execution authority, and no caller uses it in dispatch yet.
Inputs are not fsynced; a crash can leave a damaged published input, which re-verification refuses.
Tests run as an unprivileged user; read-only modes are not a confinement boundary against a privileged process.
